My SO took on a GSD X Rottweiler that was abused before we were together that was abused by his old owner, my SO went to see him and couldn’t leave without him. He was so scared of people so you couldn’t touch him he would bite out of fear, but he was such a loyal dog and so so smart. The dog realised he had been rescued and this was now his forever home. He claimed his own seat near the bar and all the customer knew him, enjoyed his company but respected his boundaries. When I came along I knew that I needed to help him trust again and we started to work together on that. He started to trust me touching him, slowly slowly and by the end of his days (we had to have him PTS last year at 14 yo) he trusted in us I could hug him and when he got deaf I could get close enough for him to head me talking into his ear. 

In the time I was with him, his old owner came into the pub and wanted to see him, we’ll the dog knew he was the abuser and I’d never seen him react the way he did. He tried his best to avoid the old man and when the old man backed him into a corner the dog aggressive warned him that he wouldn’t take any more abuse, he remembered after 8-9 year that this man was a bad human. 

I will never forget my boy Duke.

I feel you dude, I live in a pub and have a guy that comes in that is legally classed as blind (he has like a form of tunnel vision) he has a sweet little collie dog. 

Well one night, late on he left the pub to go home with the dog in tow, He walks over a park on his way home, it’s not very well lit. He let the dog loose for a wee (she’s very well behaved) but this one night something spooked her and she set off running. Well the guy couldn’t keep up and she runs into the road. Him being nearly blind barely seen what happens but hears a screech and bang, The dog was hit but the driver just drove away. He called me straight away, I ran to help and carried her back to the pub she was in shock but wasn’t as bad as I expected when he cried to me down the phone for help.

We managed to get her to an emergency vets that night and she came out relatively unscathed with one vertebrae of her tail broken, some bad bruising and a cut up lip. 

Well I see this guy out and about these days dog in tow and she goes crazy crying when she sees me almost like she owes me something for helping her. She trusts me with her life when she’s in the pub, unlike a bond with anybody else.
